orca_env: <Orca environment id of the devbox's orca serve, as the laptop app sees it>
devbox_instance_id: <EC2 instance id of the devbox, i-...; setup-devbox.sh fills it from the instance metadata>
devbox_region: <AWS region of the devbox, e.g. us-west-2; setup-devbox.sh fills it; optional>
devbox_aws_profile: <AWS CLI profile on the laptop that may start and stop the devbox; optional>
